summary: Land acquisition valuation; compensation rate dispute under Land Acquisition Act, 1894 s.4-6-11-17-18; market value determination based on sale exemplar dated 16.12.1988; erroneous reading of 400 sq. yd. measurement as 400 Rs/sq. yd. rate questioned; parity claim under Bir Singh v. State of UP precedent; agricultural vs abadi land classification; deduction for development works challenged; High Court enhanced rate from 222/233 to 449 or 340 Rs/sq. yd. depending on case stage; NOIDA appeals against Bir Singh-based enhancements; landowners seek parity with Bir Singh's 449 Rs/sq. yd. rate; Section 28A applicability contested.
final_judgment: Not explicitly stated in given text; matter appears pending as court states 'we have heard learned Senior Counsels at considerable length...'
